title: Engine Controller Internal Abnormality
detail_of_failure: Error occurs in the internal memory of the engine controller or internal power supply circuit.
machine_effect: Engine can stop during operation, or it cannot be started while it is stopped.
related_information: • The power supply voltage of the engine controller can be checked with the monitoring function. (Code: 03203) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Start the engine.

steps.procedure: Check if other failure codes are shown at the same time. If other codes are shown, do the troubleshooting for them.

steps.cause: Do the troubleshooting for failure code [CA441].
